mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% for 3 months and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate increase exceeding 0.5% (CPIAUCSL > 0.5% MoM) signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% MoM, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in employment (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market weakness (HOUST < 1000) signals economic distress, often triggering central bank intervention and market rebound, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1000, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 (INDPRO > 105) signals robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 105, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Residential fixed investment below 400000 (RSAFS < 400000) signals a weakening housing market, often triggering market stimulus and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS < 400000, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong policy response to economic weakness, supporting equity markets and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS falls and UNRATE falls simultaneously, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation exceeding 238.0 (CPIAUCSL > 238.0) signals inflationary pressure, often leading to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 238.0, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of such periods.
